name: Ddim7
notes: Open-position diminished 7th. Classic passing chord between D and Em7 or between C and Dm.

name: Fdim7
notes: The four-string dim7, root on string 4. Slide it up three frets: same chord, new inversion.

name: Caug
notes: Open C with the G raised to G♯ on string 3.

name: Bdim
notes: The plain diminished triad (vii in C major), root on string 5.
